tools.name: Add board

desc.title: Desc
desc.description: Description for the Trello board (0-16384 characters).

name.title: Name

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: Whether the board should be immediately archived (closed).

subscribed.title: Subscribed
subscribed.description: Whether the creator is automatically subscribed to the board.

prefs_voting.title: Prefs Voting

idBoardSource.title: Id Board Source

prefs__cardAging.description: Card aging style ('pirate' or 'regular'); corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/cardAging'.

prefs_background.title: Prefs Background

prefs_cardCovers.title: Prefs Card Covers

prefs__cardCovers.title: Prefs  Card Covers
prefs__cardCovers.description: Whether card covers are shown; corresponds to API parameter 'prefs/cardCovers'.

labelNames__orange.title: Label Names  Orange

tools.name: Add card
tools.description: Creates a new card in a Trello list. Only `idList` is required; `idBoard` is optional as the API determines the board from the list.

due.title: Due
due.description: Due date for the card (date string or 'null' to remove).

pos.title: Pos
pos.description: Position in list: 'top', 'bottom', or a positive float.

desc.title: Desc
examples: This is a sample card description.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name/title for the card. Highly recommended for new cards. If omitted, a blank title is created. When using 'idCardSource' to copy a card, the name is copied from the source unless overridden here.

idList.title: Id List
idList.description: ID of the list to add the card to. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal string.

idBoard.title: Id Board
idBoard.description: ID of the board for the card. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal string. Optional - the API automatically determines the board from idList.

idLabels.title: Id Labels
idLabels.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs to add. Each ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string.

idMembers.title: Id Members
idMembers.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs to assign. Each ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string.

urlSource.title: Url Source
urlSource.description: URL to attach to the card. If a Trello card URL is provided, the card is copied from that source. Use 'null' or omit if not needed.

fileSource.title: File Source
fileSource.description: Binary data of a file to attach.

subscribed.title: Subscribed
subscribed.description: Subscribe user to the card. Valid values: 'true', 'false'.

idCardSource.title: Id Card Source
idCardSource.description: ID of an existing card to copy. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal string. When provided, the new card inherits name and other properties from the source card.

keepFromSource.title: Keep From Source
keepFromSource.description: If using `idCardSource`, properties to copy: 'all' or comma-separated (e.g., 'attachments', 'checklists', 'due').

idAttachmentCover.title: Id Attachment Cover
idAttachmentCover.description: ID of an image attachment on this card for its cover, or 'null' for no cover. Must be a 24-character hexadecimal string or 'null'.

tools.name: Add comment to card
tools.description: Adds a new text comment, which can include @mentions, to a Trello card specified by its ID; file attachments are not supported via this action.

text.title: Text
examples: What's the status on this task? @username
text.description: Comment text, between 1 and 16384 characters. Supports @mentions to notify Trello users.

idCard.title: Id Card
idCard.description: ID or shortLink of the Trello card to add the comment to.

tools.name: Add new list to board
tools.description: Creates a new list on a specified Trello board, with options to copy an existing list, set its position, initial state (archived/subscribed), and does not modify existing lists or move cards.

input.title: AddListsRequest

pos.title: Pos
pos.description: The position of the new list on the board. Valid values are `top`, `bottom`, or a positive number (e.g., '1', '2.5').

name.title: Name
name.description: The name for the new list. Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384 characters. This is a required parameter.

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: Indicates whether the list should be created as closed (archived). Set to `true` for closed, or `false` for open.

idBoard.title: Id Board
idBoard.description: The ID of the board to which the new list should be added. This is a required parameter.

subscribed.title: Subscribed
subscribed.description: Indicates whether the user creating the list should be automatically subscribed to it. Set to `true` to subscribe, or `false` otherwise.

idListSource.title: Id List Source
idListSource.description: The ID of an existing list to copy when creating the new list. If provided, the new list will be a copy of this source list.

input.description: Request schema for creating a new list on a Trello board.

tools.name: Delete card by ID
tools.description: Permanently deletes an archived Trello card specified by its `idCard`.

idCard.title: Id Card
idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card to be deleted. The card ID is a long alphanumeric string, while the shortLink is a shorter, unique identifier used in card URLs.

tools.name: Get board by id
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific Trello board by its ID; this is a read-only action.

input.title: GetBoardsByIdBoardRequest

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Filters the cards to be returned. Valid values: 'all', 'closed', 'none', 'open', or 'visible'.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Filters the lists on the board to be returned. Valid values: 'all', 'closed', 'none', or 'open'.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for the board object itself. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: closed, dateLastActivity, dateLastView, desc, descData, idOrganization, invitations, invited, labelNames, memberships, name, pinned, powerUps, prefs, shortLink, shortUrl, starred, subscribed, url.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Filters the labels to be returned. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Filters the actions to be returned. Specify 'all' or provide a comma-separated list of action types. Valid types include: addAttachmentToCard, addChecklistToCard, addMemberToBoard, addMemberToCard, addMemberToOrganization, addToOrganizationBoard, commentCard, convertToCardFromCheckItem, copyBoard, copyCard, copyCommentCard, createBoard, createCard, createList, createOrganization, deleteAttachmentFromCard, deleteBoardInvitation, deleteCard, deleteOrganizationInvitation, disablePowerUp, emailCard, enablePowerUp, makeAdminOfBoard, makeNormalMemberOfBoard, makeNormalMemberOfOrganization, makeObserverOfBoard, memberJoinedTrello, moveCardFromBoard, moveCardToBoard, moveListFromBoard, moveListToBoard, removeChecklistFromCard, removeFromOrganizationBoard, removeMemberFromCard, unconfirmedBoardInvitation, unconfirmedOrganizationInvitation, updateBoard, updateCard, updateCard:closed, updateCard:desc, updateCard:idList, updateCard:name, updateCheckItemStateOnCard, updateChecklist, updateList, updateList:closed, updateList:name, updateMember, or updateOrganization.

idBoard.title: Id Board
idBoard.description: The unique identifier (ID) of the Trello board. Must be either a 24-character hexadecimal long-form ID (e.g., '68f9e68ace7e944875655da6') or an 8-character alphanumeric short-form ID (e.g., '8aBemlak'). Board names are NOT valid. Use TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER with idMember='me' to list boards and get their IDs.

members.title: Members
members.description: Filters the members of the board to be returned. Valid values: 'admins', 'all', 'none', 'normal', or 'owners'.

myPrefs.title: My Prefs
myPrefs.description: Determines whether to include the current user's preferences for this board. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

boardStars.title: Board Stars
boardStars.description: Filters board stars. Valid values: 'mine' (stars by the current user) or 'none'.

checklists.title: Checklists
checklists.description: Filters board-level checklists to be returned. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.

card_fields.title: Card Fields
card_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for card objects. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, url.

list_fields.title: List Fields
list_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for list objects. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list: closed, idBoard, name, pos, subscribed.

memberships.title: Memberships
memberships.description: Filters board memberships to return. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list of types: active, admin, deactivated, me, normal.

label_fields.title: Label Fields
label_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for label objects. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list: color, idBoard, name, uses.

labels_limit.title: Labels Limit
labels_limit.description: The maximum number of labels to return, ranging from 0 to 1000.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Determines whether to include the organization object to which the board belongs. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

action_fields.title: Action Fields
action_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for action objects. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list of fields: data, date, idMemberCreator, type. Defaults to 'all'.

action_member.title: Action Member
action_member.description: Determines whether to include the member object within actions. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

actions_limit.title: Actions Limit
actions_limit.description: The maximum number of actions to return, ranging from 0 to 1000. Defaults to 50 if not specified.

actions_since.title: Actions Since
actions_since.description: Filters actions to those that occurred after a specific date (ISO 8601 format), or 'lastView'. Use null for no date filtering.

card_stickers.title: Card Stickers
card_stickers.description: Determines whether to include stickers on cards. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

member_fields.title: Member Fields
member_fields.description: Specifies fields for member objects. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

actions_format.title: Actions Format
actions_format.description: Specifies the format for returned actions. Valid values: 'count', 'list', or 'minimal'. Defaults to 'list' if not specified.

membersInvited.title: Members Invited
membersInvited.description: Filters invited members of the board. Valid values: 'admins', 'all', 'none', 'normal', or 'owners'.

actions_display.title: Actions Display
actions_display.description: Determines whether to return display objects for actions. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

card_checklists.title: Card Checklists
card_checklists.description: Filters the checklists on cards to be returned. Valid values: 'all' or 'none'.

actions_entities.title: Actions Entities
actions_entities.description: Determines whether to return entity objects for actions. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

card_attachments.title: Card Attachments
card_attachments.description: Determines whether to include card attachments. Set to 'true', 'false', or 'cover' (for only card cover attachments).

checklist_fields.title: Checklist Fields
checklist_fields.description: Specifies fields for board-level checklist objects. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list: idBoard, idCard, name, pos.

memberships_member.title: Memberships Member
memberships_member.description: Determines whether to include member objects within memberships. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

organization_fields.title: Organization Fields
organization_fields.description: Specifies fields for the organization object. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: billableMemberCount, desc, descData, displayName, idBoards, invitations, invited, logoHash, memberships, name, powerUps, prefs, premiumFeatures, products, url, website.

action_memberCreator.title: Action Member Creator
action_memberCreator.description: Determines whether to include the member creator object within actions. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

action_member_fields.title: Action Member Fields
action_member_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for member objects within actions. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

membersInvited_fields.title: Members Invited Fields
membersInvited_fields.description: Specifies fields for invited member objects. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

card_attachment_fields.title: Card Attachment Fields
card_attachment_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for card attachment objects. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: bytes, date, edgeColor, idMember, isUpload, mimeType, name, previews, url.

organization_memberships.title: Organization Memberships
organization_memberships.description: Filters organization memberships to return. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list: active, admin, deactivated, me, normal.

memberships_member_fields.title: Memberships Member Fields
memberships_member_fields.description: Specifies fields for member objects within memberships. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

action_memberCreator_fields.title: Action Member Creator Fields
action_memberCreator_fields.description: Specifies the fields to return for member creator objects within actions. Use 'all' or a comma-separated list. Valid fields: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username.

tools.name: Get cards by board ID
tools.description: Retrieves cards from an existing Trello board, allowing filtering and customization of fields for cards, attachments, and members.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of cards to return. Must be a number between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

since.title: Since
since.description: A date in ISO 8601 format. Only cards updated after this date will be returned. Use 'null' for no restriction.

before.title: Before
before.description: A date in ISO 8601 format. Only cards updated before this date will be returned. Use 'null' for no restriction.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: A comma-separated list of card fields to be returned. Use 'all' to include all fields. Valid fields include: badges, checkItemStates, closed, dateLastActivity, desc, descData, due, email, idAttachmentCover, idBoard, idChecklists, idLabels, idList, idMembers, idMembersVoted, idShort, labels, manualCoverAttachment, name, pos, shortLink, shortUrl, subscribed, or url. If not specified, defaults to 'all' on the API side.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Filters the cards to return. Valid values are 'all', 'closed', 'none', 'open', or 'visible'. If not specified, defaults to 'visible' on the API side.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: A comma-separated list of action types to be returned. Use 'all' to include all action types. Valid action types include: addAttachmentToCard, addChecklistToCard, addMemberToBoard, addMemberToCard, addMemberToOrganization, addToOrganizationBoard, commentCard, convertToCardFromCheckItem, copyBoard, copyCard, copyCommentCard, createBoard, createCard, createList, createOrganization, deleteAttachmentFromCard, deleteBoardInvitation, deleteCard, deleteOrganizationInvitation, disablePowerUp, emailCard, enablePowerUp, makeAdminOfBoard, makeNormalMemberOfBoard, makeNormalMemberOfOrganization, makeObserverOfBoard, memberJoinedTrello, moveCardFromBoard, moveCardToBoard, moveListFromBoard, moveListToBoard, removeChecklistFromCard, removeFromOrganizationBoard, removeMemberFromCard, unconfirmedBoardInvitation, unconfirmedOrganizationInvitation, updateBoard, updateCard, updateCard:closed, updateCard:desc, updateCard:idList, updateCard:name, updateCheckItemStateOnCard, updateChecklist, updateList, updateList:closed, updateList:name, updateMember, or updateOrganization.

idBoard.title: Id Board
idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board. Valid formats: 24-character hexadecimal ID (e.g., '60d5f2f1c8a8b4002b8f0123') OR 8-character shortLink (e.g., 'TH6F0pTM'). Human-readable board names or URL slugs (e.g., 'my-board', 'tech-jcorp') are NOT valid identifiers. In the URL 'trello.com/b/TH6F0pTM/my-board', 'TH6F0pTM' is the valid shortLink, while 'my-board' is just a slug and cannot be used. To find your board ID or shortLink: use TRELLO_GET_MEMBERS_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER to list your boards, or look at the board URL in your browser.

members.title: Members
members.description: Determines whether members should be returned. Valid values are 'true' or 'false'.

stickers.title: Stickers
stickers.description: Determines whether stickers should be returned. Valid values are 'true' or 'false'.

checklists.title: Checklists
checklists.description: Determines which checklists to return. Valid values are 'all' or 'none'. If not specified, defaults to 'none' on the API side.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Determines whether attachments should be returned. Can be 'true', 'false', or 'cover' (to return only card cover attachments).

member_fields.title: Member Fields
member_fields.description: A comma-separated list of member fields to be returned. Use 'all' to include all fields. Valid fields include: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, or username. checkItemStates.title: Check Item States
checkItemStates.description: Determines whether check item states should be returned. Valid values are 'true' or 'false'.

attachment_fields.title: Attachment Fields
attachment_fields.description: A comma-separated list of attachment fields to be returned. Use 'all' to include all fields. Valid fields include: bytes, date, edgeColor, idMember, isUpload, mimeType, name, previews, or url. If not specified, defaults to 'all' on the API side.

tools.name: Search Trello
tools.description: Searches Trello content (e.g., boards, cards, members) within specified organizations using a query and customizable result fields. IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: - Search indexing has a delay: newly created/updated cards may not appear for several minutes. - For exact name matching or time-sensitive lookups, use TRELLO_GET_LISTS_CARDS_BY_ID_LIST or TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_CARDS_BY_ID_BOARD to enumerate cards directly, then filter by name. - The search uses word tokenization: queries like 'Payment failed when sending tips' are split into individual terms ['Payment', 'failed', 'when', 'sending', 'tips']. Common words may be ignored. - Set partial='true' (default) for better recall with prefix matching on the last search term.

input.title: GetSearchRequest

query.title: Query
query.description: The search query string. Trello tokenizes the query into individual words and searches for cards/boards/etc. containing those terms. Note: Common words like 'when', 'the', 'is' may be ignored as stop words.

idCards.title: Id Cards
idCards.description: A comma-separated list of card IDs to search for. Each card ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f'). Do NOT use the short card ID from the card URL.

partial.title: Partial
partial.description: Enable partial/prefix matching for search terms ('true' or 'false'). Default is 'true'. When true, the last word in the query will match word prefixes (e.g., 'pay' matches 'payment'). When false, only exact word matches are returned. Setting to 'true' (recommended) improves search recall, especially for card names that may not be indexed immediately after creation.

idBoards.title: Id Boards
idBoards.description: A comma-separated list of board IDs to search within, or 'mine' to search all boards the user is a member of (default). Each board ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f'). Do NOT use the short 8-character ID from the board URL (e.g., 'VGflYpta' from 'trello.com/b/VGflYpta/board-name'). To get the correct ID, use the TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_BY_ID_MEMBER action or extract it from API responses.

card_list.title: Card List
card_list.description: Whether to include the list object for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

card_board.title: Card Board
card_board.description: Whether to include the board object for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

cards_page.title: Cards Page
cards_page.description: Page number for paginated card results. Must be 0-100. Default is 0.

modelTypes.title: Model Types
modelTypes.description: Types of Trello objects to search (e.g., 'cards,boards' or 'all' from 'actions', 'boards', 'cards', 'members', 'organizations'). Default is 'all'.

card_fields.title: Card Fields
card_fields.description: Fields for found cards; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,due'). Default is 'all'.

cards_limit.title: Cards Limit
cards_limit.description: Maximum number of card results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude cards from search results. Default is 10.

board_fields.title: Board Fields
board_fields.description: Fields for found boards; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,url'). Default is 'name,idOrganization'.

boards_limit.title: Boards Limit
boards_limit.description: Maximum number of board results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude boards from search results. Default is 10.

card_members.title: Card Members
card_members.description: Whether to include member objects for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

card_stickers.title: Card Stickers
card_stickers.description: Whether to include sticker objects for each card returned ('true' or 'false').

member_fields.title: Member Fields
member_fields.description: Fields for found members; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'fullName,username'). Default is 'avatarHash,fullName,initials,username,confirmed'.

members_limit.title: Members Limit
members_limit.description: Maximum number of member results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude members from search results. Default is 10.

idOrganizations.title: Id Organizations
idOrganizations.description: A comma-separated list of organization (workspace) IDs to search within. Each organization ID must be a 24-character hexadecimal string (e.g., '5f9f1b9b8f8f8f8f8f8f8f8f').

card_attachments.title: Card Attachments
card_attachments.description: Whether to include attachments for cards ('true', 'false', or 'cover' for card cover attachments).

organization_fields.title: Organization Fields
organization_fields.description: Fields for found organizations; 'all' or a comma-separated list (e.g., 'name,url'). Default is 'name,displayName'.

organizations_limit.title: Organizations Limit
organizations_limit.description: Maximum number of organization results (1-1000). Use 0 to exclude organizations from search results. Default is 10.

input.description:
Request schema for `GetSearch` action. Defines the parameters for searching Trello content.

IMPORTANT: Trello search has an indexing delay - newly created or updated cards may not appear
in search results for several minutes. For time-sensitive or exact name matching, consider using
TRELLO_GET_LISTS_CARDS_BY_ID_LIST or TRELLO_GET_BOARDS_CARDS_BY_ID_BOARD to enumerate cards directly.

tools.name: Update card attributes
tools.description: Updates an existing Trello card's attributes like name, description, due date, members, labels, position, or archives/unarchives it, attaches files, or changes its cover.

due.title: Due
due.description: The new due date for the card, in ISO 8601 format, or 'null' to remove the due date.

pos.title: Pos
pos.description: The new position of the card within its list. Can be 'top', 'bottom', or a positive floating-point number. Higher numbers are further down the list.

desc.title: Desc
desc.description: The new description for the card. String length must be from 0 to 16384 characters.

name.title: Name
name.description: The new name for the card. Required if not copying the name from `idCardSource`, `fileSource`, or `urlSource`.

closed.title: Closed
closed.description: Determines whether the card should be archived (closed). Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCard.title: Id Card
idCard.description: The ID or shortLink of the card to update.

idList.title: Id List
idList.description: The ID of the list to move the card to.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Comma-separated list of label colors (e.g., 'green,yellow,red') to apply, overwriting existing labels. Use 'idLabels' for more precise control. 'all' may add all available label colors.

idBoard.title: Id Board
idBoard.description: The ID of the board to move the card to. If `idList` is also provided, the card will be moved to that list on the new board.

idLabels.title: Id Labels
idLabels.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs to apply, replacing existing labels. To preserve existing labels, fetch current `idLabels`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

idMembers.title: Id Members
idMembers.description: Comma-separated list of member IDs to assign, replacing existing members. To preserve existing members, fetch current `idMembers`, append new ones, and submit the combined list.

urlSource.title: Url Source
urlSource.description: A URL to be attached to the card (e.g., a link to an external resource). If the card is being created from a URL (e.g. via a bookmarklet), this will be the source URL. Set to 'null' or an empty string to remove an existing attachment link created this way.

fileSource.title: File Source
fileSource.description: The URL of a file to be attached to the card. Trello will fetch and attach the file from this URL.

subscribed.title: Subscribed
subscribed.description: Determines whether the user is subscribed to the card. Accepts boolean (true/false) or string ('true'/'false').

idCardSource.title: Id Card Source
idCardSource.description: The ID of a card to copy properties from. Requires `keepFromSource` to be specified.

keepFromSource.title: Keep From Source
keepFromSource.description: If `idCardSource` is specified, this is a comma-separated list of properties to copy from the source card. Valid values are 'all', or any combination of 'attachments', 'checklists', 'comments', 'customFields', 'due', 'labels', 'members', 'pluginData', 'stickers'.

idAttachmentCover.title: Id Attachment Cover
idAttachmentCover.description: The ID of an existing image attachment to be used as the card cover. Use 'null' or an empty string to remove the cover.
